text:
micah: Quick sync — XenoCompute asked for a joint perf/W benchmark next quarter. Can we map owners + timeline? @anika @raj
anika: Owners: Raj -> kernel tuning, Lena -> bench infra, Carl -> partner comms. Micah, what are target metrics? :eyes:
raj: Targets: ~50% perf/W vs their current baseline on Xeno A1 at batch=2. Latency SLO: p50 < 150ms for embed workload. We'll confirm exact workloads.
lena: We need telemetry hooks in their image. Bench harness needs prometheus /metrics + kvcache dumps. @benchbot can ingest telemetry?
benchbot: benchbot: telemetry ingest is enabled. Send sample metrics endpoint and test creds.
carl: Marketing/marketplace note — we can't announce until partner embargo lifted (T-2 weeks). I'll draft a joint one-pager for the marketplace listing and press.
micah: Ops plan proposed: 1) dry run in our lab (week 1) 2) partner-run in partner lab (week 2) 3) public writeup and marketplace listing (week 4). Any blockers?
lena: Blocker: kernel patch needed for page-table flush optimization — Raj estimates ~3d dev + 1d validation. Also need reproducible nightly image. Snippet for running bench:
```bash
./run_bench.sh --target xeno-a1 --batch 2 --seq 2048 \
  --telemetry-url http://metrics.internal:9090 --kvcache true
```
anika: Can we capture power/watt data? Partner says they have an SNMP wattmeter in lab.
raj: Yes — we'll run a power matrix at 200W/250W/300W and confirm stability. Need to test quantization/conv kernels under cap.
micah: Action items:
- Raj: kernel PR + perf regression checks (due in 5d)
- Lena: bench infra + telemetry ingest + schedule dry run (due in 7d)
- Carl: press sync + marketplace checklist draft (due in 10d)
- Anika: coordinate partner access, NDA & creds (due in 3d)
xeno-eng: Thanks — we'll provide the test image, SNMP creds, and power profiles by EOD tomorrow.
carl: Added checklist doc: https://drive.redwood/test-xeno-bench — please drop the runbook and preflight checklist there.
micah: :thumbsup: Meeting Thursday 09:00 PT to review dry-run. Calendar invite sent.
lena: Dry run will kick off overnight to capture thermals. Repro tag: xeno-a1-20260301. Artifacts -> s3://bench-results/xeno/4271357920/
benchbot: benchbot: scheduled dry-run job #4271358001 queued.
anika: Security note — private image will be reviewed by eng-security. Looping them in now.
micah: Thanks all — ping me if anything slips. We'll sync after dry-run and decide go/no-go for joint announcement.
